newsitem.title: USA: Vintage offshore White Heron well finds gas.
newsitem.headline: Vintage offshore White Heron well finds gas.

text.p: Vintage Petroleum Inc said it has drilled a discovery well, State Tract 77 - 1, in the White Heron area of Galveston Bay, Texas, that tested at four million cubic feet of gas per day, net to Vintage.
The well was drilled to a depth of 12,500 feet encountering over 90 feet of net pay from two productive zones of Text II sands, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
Production is anticipated to commence in early September 1997, following completion of pipeline construction and platform installation.
The well is approximately two miles east of recent Vintage discoveries in the Umbrella Point East area.
Vintage and its partner, Enserch Exploration Inc, the project operator, each has a 50 percent working interest in the well.
Also, Vintage and Enserch Exploration were successful in acquiring three nearby tracts in an April lease sale.
